reasoning_traces.think:
The core mathematical framework combines ordinal probit regression with distributed lag structures to capture temporal dependencies in athlete wellness. The latent variable formulation Z̃_ijt = μ_ijt + ε_ijt allows modeling ordinal wellness scores through continuous latent variables, which are then linked to cumulative training and recovery inputs. Hierarchical Bayesian modeling enables borrowing strength across athletes while preserving individual-specific lag patterns. The key innovation lies in computing relative importance R_j = |C_j| / Σ|C_j'|, replacing uniform weighting with model-derived signal relevance. This supports robust inference under uncertainty and enables GSE to make adaptive decisions about player availability. Failure modes include misalignment between assumed lag structures and actual physiological response times, or insufficient data to estimate individual-specific deviations reliably.
